records.verificationNote: Read directly from the UnitedHealthcare 2026 Prescription Drug List (PDL), effective January 1, 2026, page 48 (Respiratory Tract / Pulmonary Agents - Drugs for Asthma and COPD section), and page 5 (Symbols key: E = may be excluded from coverage or subject to PA in CT, NJ, NY; PA = prior authorization required; QL = quantity limit). Confirmed: 'albuterol sulfate hfa aerosol solution 108 (90 base) mcg/act inhalation' is listed as Tier 2 with QL. PROVENTIL HFA and VENTOLIN HFA (brand equivalents) are both marked 'E' indicating PA/exclusion eligibility rather than clean coverage. Levalbuterol hcl inhalation and LEVALBUTEROL HFA/XOPENEX HFA are Tier 3 with QL (covered but non-preferred, higher cost-share). Nebulizer solution and oral syrup forms of generic albuterol sulfate are confirmed Tier 1. Sig/dosing (2 puffs q4-6h PRN) is standard SABA rescue dosing per FDA label, not stated verbatim in the PDL (the PDL lists coverage/tier only, not directions for use) -- inferred from standard clinical practice, hence marking sig details as inferred within an overall verified coverage picture. [Reused: same national UHC commercial PDL as the MD guide (2026-10-21); outside CT/NJ/NY its 'E' symbol means may be excluded]
